holderPosition.legalForm: A token AgriFintech Financial Technologies Inc. describes as backed by wheat at one kilogram per token; the reviewed sources do not establish allocated title, a delivery right or what exactly the issuer owes the holder
holderPosition.says: The holder has whatever the issuer's terms give, which the reviewed sources do not define: the product page describes a quantity backing, not title to identified wheat or a right to delivery. No current redemption procedure was established.

statements.says: Redeemed N tokens and delivered N kilograms of wheat (or paid) to the holder.

today.where: The reviewed sources describe no current redemption procedure, minimums, fees or delivery conditions

statements.says: The guide names the token contract but not its admin powers; the controls for issuing, pausing, upgrades and transfers were not verified. A trade on an exchange or CroptoDEX moves tokens and records no hand-over of wheat.

outside.says: Buying grain, controlling issuance and reconciling warehouse stocks stay with Cropto and its counterparties.
What is owed, minimum quantities, fees and delivery conditions belong in the issuer's terms; the sources did not establish them.
Access through exchanges and CroptoDEX stays with those venues.

ingredients.label: Kilograms against total token supply, under 30 days
Warehouse 'I have it' statements, under 30 days

verdict.summary: Fungible wheat fits A/H/T with kilograms, a backed status and an audit, so the outline can be said. The token is an ERC-20 on Polygon the reader cannot read, a reserve across represented networks has no structured form, and the claim kind cannot be chosen because the sources do not say what the issuer owes. No warehouse, inspector or auditor is identified, and the one reserve report could not be read.
